Every source_fingerprints file re-hashed to its pinned digest, each checked record's text_path re-hashed to its text_sha256, and each quoted text equals the exact char_start:char_end slice of its held file. I read the original in full (7 FR 7328): EO 9245 of Sept. 16, 1942, under the First War Powers Act, transfers the functions, personnel, records, property and funds of the High Commissioner to the Philippine Islands to the Secretary of the Interior; identity is confirmed and the order states no term. The held FR text of EO 9616 (10 FR 11837, Sept. 14, 1945) says in paragraph 1 that Executive Order No. 9245 of September 16, 1942 is hereby repealed and transfers everything back to the High Commissioner, with no deferred effective date; the APP text matches. Cruden found only EO 9616 texts naming EO 9245, so no earlier end is shown, any statutory war-powers lapse would come later, and status no holds from 1945-09-14.
